text: ITEM 1 | About 20 tan-brown, oval, firm pieces with smooth dry skin and faint lengthwise ridges, lightly darker on the edges, with a matte to slightly sheen surface and no visible oil or char. Each piece is about 2.5 cm long and 1.5 cm wide, and they are loosely piled in a cluster, some overlapping, in the center-left of a white square plate, with faint pinkish smears on the plate beside them. | 26
